sources.name: ONRC — Oficiul National al Registrului Comertului
sources.verdict: The national trade register. Fetch attempt returned a WAF access-denied page (support-ID block) from datacenter IP — real and authoritative, but automated access needs residential/browser routing or the data.gov.ro bulk route.

sources.name: ONRC RECOM Online portal
sources.verdict: RECOM online company lookup; known to offer free basic search after account creation, paid certificates/extracts. DNS resolution failed from our fetcher this session — not verified live; treat as account-gated, not bulk.

sources.name: data.gov.ro — ONRC bulk company datasets
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 76 ONRC datasets incl. 'Firme inregistrate la Registrul Comertului' as dated CSV snapshots (Jul/Aug/Oct 2025 versions seen), plus status-code nomenclatures and authorized-activities CSVs. CC-BY-4.0 / OGL-ROU. This is the $0 deterministic backbone for RO companies.

sources.name: data.gov.ro CKAN API
sources.verdict: National open-data portal runs CKAN; the portal itself confirms API access. Use for programmatic discovery/refresh of ONRC + SEAP dataset resources.

sources.name: ANAF taxpayer web service (VAT/status by CUI)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via official doc (static.anaf.ro doc_WS_V8.txt): free public REST API, POST up to 100 CUIs/request, max 1 req/sec; returns VAT status, active/inactive, e-Invoice registration. Excellent deterministic enrichment for every RO entity.

sources.name: Ministerul Finantelor — fiscal info & annual financial statements lookup
sources.verdict: Well-known free lookup of company fiscal data and annual balance-sheet summaries by CUI. Connection reset during verification (likely anti-bot) — real service, needs browser-grade fetching.

sources.name: ASF — registers of authorized entities (hub)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Hub page linking registers across all three ASF sectors: insurance (RO insurers, EEA passporting, intermediaries, claims adjusters), capital markets, private pensions.

sources.name: ASF — Registrul instrumentelor si investitiilor financiare (capital-markets register app)
sources.verdict: asfromania.ro/registru 302-redirects here (VERIFIED redirect); app itself returned 403 to our fetcher. Covers SAI/ManCos, AFIA (AIFMs), SSIF investment firms, funds. Project has already harvested ASF registers — extend to insurance/pension sections.

sources.name: ASF — insurance sector registers
sources.verdict: VERIFIED on hub: registers of RO insurers and principal intermediaries, EEA insurers/intermediaries, secondary intermediaries, claims-adjustment specialists. LP-side coverage for the insurance channel.

sources.name: ASF — private pensions market register
sources.verdict: VERIFIED on hub: register of private pension market entities (Pillar II/III administrators and funds) — the domestic institutional LP base.

sources.name: BNR — Registre si liste (credit institutions, payment & e-money institutions)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED structure: registers for credit institutions, IFN, payment institutions, e-money institutions under Reglementare si autorizare > Registre si liste. Pages are server-rendered ASPX — parseable.

sources.name: BNR — Registrul IFN (non-bank financial institutions)
sources.verdict: Register of IFNs (General/Special/Evidence registers) — direct lenders, leasing, factoring, consumer finance, i.e. the private-debt entity spine. Navigation confirmed; the hint says this register is open — detail page not re-verified this session.

sources.name: BNR — exchange rates XML (Curs XML)
sources.verdict: 'Curs XML' link confirmed on BNR homepage; canonical daily RON reference-rate XML for deterministic currency conversion (store alongside ECB rates).

sources.name: Monitorul Oficial al Romaniei
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Official gazette; e-Monitor gives free same-day + archive viewing; Partea IV carries company/professional notices; Partea VI procurement. Full-text search (Expert-Monitor) is a paid subscription.

sources.name: BPI — Buletinul Procedurilor de Insolventa
sources.verdict: Official ONRC-published insolvency proceedings bulletin — the core distressed-debt signal source. Connection refused from datacenter IP this session; known model: free debtor summary search, paid subscription for full bulletin access.

sources.name: Portal Just — Romanian courts portal
sources.verdict: Public case-file (dosare) search by party across all courts; a public SOAP query service (portalquery.just.ro) is widely used by local data providers. Connection refused from our fetcher — needs alternate routing; not verified live this session.

sources.name: Bursa de Valori Bucuresti (BVB) — listed shares / issuer list
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Full issuer table (Premium/Standard/International/AeRO segments) with symbols, ISINs, prices; 'Descarcare rapida' spreadsheet export present. Paid real-time data via BVB data-sales for anything beyond.

sources.name: Depozitarul Central (Romanian CSD)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. BVB-group CSD; publishes issuer/corporate-events statistics, settlement participant rankings, dividend payment data. Maintains shareholder registers (not public in full).

sources.name: Bursa Romana de Marfuri (BRM) — commodities exchange
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Gas/power spot-forward-futures markets, PPA and Guarantees-of-Origin markets, CO2 emission-certificate trading ring, ROGAS indices, market bulletins — relevant to energy-transition and carbon alts.

sources.name: AAF — Asociatia Administratorilor de Fonduri (member list)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. ~28 members enumerated: local ManCos (BT AM, BRD AM, Erste AM, Raiffeisen AM, Patria...), the five former-SIF closed-end investors (Evergent, Lion Capital, Transilvania Investments, Infinity Capital, Muntenia Invest), Fondul Proprietatea, foreign distributors. Fund statistics portal at rapoarte.aaf.ro.

sources.name: ROPEA — Romanian Private Equity & Venture Capital Association
sources.verdict: 403 to our fetcher (per hint: member logo grid). Real association, key GP roster for RO PE/VC. Retry via headless browser with standard UA, or cross-check membership via Invest Europe directory.

sources.name: APAPR — private pension funds association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED live. Pillar II/III association; member administrators and market stats live in 'Utile'/news sections. Complements the ASF pensions register on the LP side.

sources.name: UNSAR — insurers association (member list)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 23 member insurers (~90% of market): Allianz-Tiriac, Generali, NN, Groupama etc.; publishes market press/statistics.

sources.name: ARB — Asociatia Romana a Bancilor
sources.verdict: Banking association with member bank list. Connection refused from datacenter IP this session — real organization, not verified live; BNR credit-institution register is the authoritative fallback.

sources.name: ALCCR (formerly ALB Romania) — leasing & consumer credit association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (alb-romania.ro 301-redirects to alccr.ro). Leasing/consumer-finance association with member logo carousel and Studies section — maps the NBFI/asset-backed lending ecosystem.

sources.name: UNPIR — insolvency practitioners union (Tabloul UNPIR)
sources.verdict: 403 to fetcher. Real statutory body; maintains the roll (Tabloul) of licensed insolvency practitioners — core service-graph entities for distressed. Retry with browser routing.

sources.name: ANEVAR — authorized valuers association (Tabloul ANEVAR)
sources.verdict: 403 to fetcher. Statutory valuers body with searchable roll of authorized valuers/valuation firms (real-assets service graph). Real; needs browser-grade access.

sources.name: UNBR national lawyers table (ifep.ro)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 'Tabloul national al avocatilor' — 40,042 lawyers, filterable by 41 bars, status, practice form (individual/SCA partnerships), curator roles; paginated ASPX, parseable. Law-firm entity extraction possible via practice-form filter.

sources.name: SEAP/SICAP — e-licitatie.ro public procurement platform
sources.verdict: Confirmed reachable but renders as an Angular SPA (only 'SEAP' heading served to fetcher). Public notice/award search exists in-app; for bulk use the data.gov.ro exports instead.

sources.name: data.gov.ro — SEAP procurement bulk datasets
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 157 datasets; annual SEAP exports 2016-2026 ('Achizitii publice 2023/2024'...) in CSV/XLS/XLSX, CC-BY/OGL-ROU. Deterministic route to contract-award signals (EPC contractors, concessionaires).

sources.name: AMEPIP — state-owned enterprise monitoring agency
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Publishes SOE performance dashboards, KPI reports, board appointments and the aggregate annual corporate-governance report — the state-asset/privatization-adjacent entity map.

sources.name: Exim Banca Romaneasca (state development/export bank)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. State export-import and development bank: trade finance, export credit insurance, EU-fund co-financing, state guarantee programs. DFI node in the institutional graph.

sources.name: InvestRomania — investment promotion agency
sources.verdict: Government FDI promotion agency. Returned HTTP 503 during verification (transient) — real agency under the Economy Ministry; low data density, useful for FDI project signals.

sources.name: ANPM — EU ETS national administration (Romania)
sources.verdict: National environmental agency administering RO's EU ETS accounts/installation lists. DNS lookup failed for www.anpm.ro from our fetcher — not verified this session; prefer the EUTL for machine-readable RO account data.

sources.name: EUTL — EU Transaction Log, Romanian accounts (Union Registry)
sources.verdict: Canonical EU source for RO ETS operator accounts, installations, allocations, compliance. Not fetched this session (search budget) but a stable, well-known Commission service with downloadable data; filter registry=Romania.

sources.name: ESMA registers — MiCA CASPs & AIFMD entities (RO slice)
sources.verdict: Romania's MiCA NCAs are ASF/BNR and no consolidated national CASP register page was found; the ESMA registers portal (open data/API) is the machine route for RO-authorized CASPs, AIFMs and passporting. Not fetched this session; canonical and known-stable.

sources.name: RICS — find a surveyor/firm (Romania via international search)
sources.verdict: PARTIALLY VERIFIED: directory live, covers 150+ countries via 'International Search'; Romania-specific result page not confirmed. Use for RICS-accredited valuers alongside ANEVAR (the statutory roll).

sources.name: BVB — issuer disclosures & market news

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Global alternatives database; Romania appears thinly — a handful of CEE-regional GPs/funds with RO exposure (PE, private debt, infra), LP profiles for regional pension/insurance investors. Weak below the fund level and on local NPL/servicer ecosystem.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Regulator registers (ASF fund/AIFM lists), fund annual reports, GP press releases, association data (Invest Europe/ROPEA-adjacent stats) — all directly accessible to us via asfromania.ro registers, ROPEA, and issuer filings.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: RO deal coverage driven by press-sourced M&A/PE transactions and advisor league tables; decent on larger buyouts (e.g. former-SIF ecosystem, regional funds), sparse on local mid-market and service-graph entities.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Business press (Ziarul Financiar, Profit.ro, Business Review), law-firm/advisor deal announcements, BVB disclosures — we catalog all of these with working RSS.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strongest global platform for RO startups/VC; cooperates with local ecosystem organizations and government-linked ecosystem reports. Good founder/round data; nothing on debt, real assets, or the institutional service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: StartupCafe/Romania-Insider startup press, VC fund announcements, How to Web ecosystem reports, self-reported company data, ONRC-derived firmographics via local partners — the ONRC bulk CSVs on data.gov.ro are the direct route.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Self-reported + press-sourced RO startup/VC coverage; shallower than Dealroom locally, weak entity hygiene for RO legal names.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases, TechCrunch-style media, self-submissions; verifiable RO facts trace back to the same startup press we ingest directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Leading local company-intelligence SaaS: full RO firmographics, financials, litigation, insolvency alerts, UBO-adjacent links. The de-facto local benchmark for entity data depth.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: ONRC/RECOM data, Ministry of Finance annual financial statements, BPI insolvency bulletin, portal.just.ro court data (SOAP), Monitorul Oficial — every one of these is in our entities catalog for direct $0 ingestion.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Veteran local company directory/credit-report vendor; broad firmographic + financials coverage, older UX, API offering.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Same public spine: ONRC registrations, MF bilant data, BPI, court portal.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Local credit-risk reports and monitoring (payment incidents, insolvency risk scores) on RO companies.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: ONRC, MF financial statements, BPI, portal.just.ro, plus BNR payment-incident data where public.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Local financial-data and sector-study provider (now part of a regional group); strong on aggregated sector financials and market sizing studies frequently cited in RO business press.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: MF annual financial statements in bulk, ONRC data — both reachable directly (data.gov.ro ONRC CSVs + mfinante lookup).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Romanian-founded global company-data API (web-scale firmographics via ML crawling); not RO-specific but proof of local data-engineering talent pool; sells B2B datasets, not an alternatives-intelligence product.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Open web crawling + public registries; no unique public RO source we lack.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Lightweight local company financials/risk lookup aimed at SMEs; simpler than Termene.

searchedButAbsent: Web-search quota was already exhausted at session start (0 searches available), so discovery relied on domain knowledge verified by direct fetch; several verdicts are marked unverified accordingly. Things looked for and NOT found: (1) any official RSS feed from BNR, ASF, ONRC, or BVB — none advertised; regulator signals require page scraping; (2) an open/free bulk route for ONRC RECOM itself — RECOM stays account-gated/paid, the open slice is the data.gov.ro CSV snapshots; (3) a consolidated Romanian national MiCA/CASP register page at ASF or BNR — not found, ESMA registers are the machine route; (4) a public UBO (beneficial-ownership) access route — consistent with EU-wide restriction, correctly absent; (5) a dedicated NPL-servicer or debt-collection register — these entities live inside the BNR IFN register (recovery/collection IFNs) rather than a standalone roll; (6) working RSS for Wall-Street.ro and Property Forum — both confirmed absent after checking standard paths and HTML; (7) ROPEA member data — site 403s from datacenter IPs (known logo-grid page; needs browser routing or Invest Europe cross-reference); (8) portal.just.ro, bpi.ro, arb.ro, mfinante apps, anevar.ro, unpir.ro, g4media/economedia feeds all actively refuse datacenter traffic — a recurring RO pattern meaning the ingestion plan should assume residential/browser-grade fetching for Romanian .ro government and association sites; (9) SeeNews and Emerging Europe regional coverage was not independently verified (403); (10) no Romanian sovereign wealth/privatization successor list beyond AMEPIP was located this session.
